integrity: The universal proof is written in RESULT.md; two reproducible exhaustive programs and captured outputs provide finite cross-checks. No independent audit or publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines top three natural cardinality levels of independent-set token-jump graphs on finite prisms. It does not determine every lower level, token-slide connectivity, or all distances; finite checks n=3,...,10 corroborate but do not prove the general theorem. An unindexed equivalent result remains possible.
title: A parity transition in optimal independent-set exchanges on prism graphs
